modern: You are a slave: free speech is not for you.
original: A slave thou art: free speech is not for thee.
notification: You are a slave: free speech is not for you.
notification_original: A slave thou art: free speech is not for thee.

explained.summary: A line Marcus copied down, most likely from an old play: a slave has no right to speak freely. On its own it is just a quotation, but the point he probably saw in it is that someone enslaved to their fears and desires loses the freedom to speak honestly. The free person, in his sense, is the one with nothing inside them to be cowed by.
